notes: Per-district €/m² asking-price averages read from imot.bg's sredni-ceni pages on 2026-08-30, for 27 cities. 610 districts parsed in total after counting out 0 values outside [100, 10000] €/m² as injection sanity bounds across the 27 city page(s) that recorded a count; each city-year publishes its own `n_dropped`. The median is the headline, being resistant to long-tail districts; the mean is included for completeness. `snapshot_date` is imot.bg's own newest published snapshot, read from each page's date list — not the day we looked, which is `as_of` above. imot.bg serve a sredni-ceni page for 27 cities (`city_pages`); this run read 27 of them. 26 of 27 cities carry enough consecutive years of comparable coverage for a since-baseline comparison; the rest publish a current €/m² only. Every median and every since-baseline percentage is computed by us from imot.bg's per-district averages — imot.bg publish no city median.
